attributes.residual: Two target-only `add` and one ours-only `addi`, T108/O107, all named. The target re-materializes `add r3,r31,r30` (symbol base plus scaled index) twice, at @0x44 to reach `character` with folded displacement 3148 and at @0x168 to reach `node` with folded displacement 3252, rather than reusing the record pointer it already holds in r29; we instead reuse r29 with plain displacements 12 and 116, and we hoist an extra `addi r30,r29,2096` because `exit_dest` is written at two sites and MWCC caches the sub-pointer. Writing those two accesses explicitly off `tab + off` DOES NOT produce the re-materialization - measured twice (probe 2 real 29 -> 49, probe 4 real 29 -> 45); MWCC caches anyway and additionally degrades the `p` formation from `addi` to `mr`. That axis is measured-dead in both spellings. NEXT LANE: the remaining question is whether the two re-materializations are reachable at all, or whether they are allocator-internal; if allocator-internal the residual is a count-asymmetric 107/108 and therefore outside every postprocessor class, so it needs a source form nobody has found yet.
